basic_info.description: Welcome to 845 44th Avenue, a warm and inviting Outer Richmond home where neighborhood charm meets coastal living. Perfectly located near Ocean Beach, the Great Highway, and Golden Gate Park, this residence offers comfort today with exciting potential for the future. The main level features hardwood floors throughout, a bright Kitchen, and an open Dining/Living Room combination ideal for entertaining or relaxing after a day at the beach. Two well-proportioned Bedrooms, Sunroom and a full Bathroom complete this level, offering light-filled retreats. The lower level includes a large Garage, Laundry, Bonus Room, and direct access to an expansive Backyard, presenting endless opportunities for additional living space such as a guest suite, home office, or indoor-outdoor entertaining area. Situated on a peaceful block known for its welcoming community, the property blends the serenity of a coastal escape with city convenience. Morning surf sessions, evening walks through Golden Gate Park, and neighborhood dining are all just minutes from your front door. For those seeking San Francisco charm, expansion opportunity, and proximity to the city's greatest outdoor treasures, 845 44th Avenue is more than a homeit's a lifestyle.
